title: AI chatbots versus human healthcare professionals: a systematic review and meta-analysis of empathy in patient care

original_central_checks.interpretation: Study-specific original central criteria, including stated tolerances; not literal equality, independent audit counts or a paper-quality score.

agreement_note: The overall standardized difference reproduced as 0.871882, matching the published 0.87.
chart_scope_note: The chart covers the declared central pooling calculation, without repeating the review or its underlying studies.
failure_interpretation: All selected comparisons passed. The underlying experiments, review process and empathy measurements were outside this attempt, so their absence from the reproduced scope is an untested area rather than a failed test or a judgment on the paper's validity.
